rationale: No supported optimization has all preconditions satisfied without a contraindication. The workflow already enables caching via `subosito/flutter-action@v2` with `cache: true` in every job, so the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-cache contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists" is met; adding another dependency cache would be redundant and the pip-cache experiment evidence is for a different ecosystem. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply because there is no matrix. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT cannot be applied because ci_history shows no completed runs, so the precondition "Representative successful-duration history exists" is unmet and a safe timeout cannot be derived. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because the workflow contains a publish/deployment job to pub.dev. Change-filtering, workflow-skip, test-selection, and build-selection patterns are contraindicated for a reusable `workflow_call` whose jobs serve as required checks. Build/Bazel/environment/history-based patterns lack applicable prerequisites in this repository.
